policy.summary: Progression items DO generate in expedition sectors (Strategy A: no generation-side filtering). Renewable reset safety is enforced by acquisition-state tracking: pre-reset inventory snapshot of PROGRESSION_ITEM containers must match baseline exactly, and post-reset validation must prove identical re-generation, never extra copies.
reset_rules: Any PROGRESSION_ITEM delta vs baseline -> RESET REFUSED
Post-reset validation compares progression-container contents hash against fresh-generation baseline
UNIQUE_ITEM sources must never be located inside renewable sectors; if found -> sector marked LOCKED and excluded from reset
